notes.title: Hostile Dreams 2 store page is live now
notes.content:
[b]Hi!

I would like to announce that Hostile Dreams 2 Steam page is now live!
Please add it to your wishlist to be the first to know about the release, updates, and the upcoming Demo. 

Thank you for your support![/b]

[previewyoutube=fuY5qciBtEM;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

[b]An extremely challenging psycho-horror platformer with unique ragdoll controls – partially inspired by my dreams.[/b]

[i]The idea for Hostile Dreams came to me a few years ago. I’ve had recurring dreams where I’m being chased or find myself in a helpless situation—unable to move or run, just flying aimlessly. With Hostile Dreams, I wanted to capture and convey that feeling of helplessness.

I released the first part in 2023, but as it was my first game, it had its fair share of flaws. Now, with the second installment, I’ve aimed to refine and expand upon that core concept in a more polished form.[/i]
